Hariyama

Fighting

Hoenn · Generation 3

Hariyama is a Fighting-type Arm Thrust Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 2.3 m tall and weighs 253.8 kg. It evolves from Makuhita. Its highest base stat is HP (144), with a base stat total of 474.
